items.title: New formulas for coastal wave heights and periods
items.text: Al Khalili, Christou and Karmpadakis fit Hrms and mean energy period to 2 million SWASH waves over five bed slopes.

items.title: Damping and nonlinear transfer coupled in one kinetic equation
items.text: Ransome, Alberello and Proment derive it; total dissipation barely changes, but energy shifts noticeably between frequencies.
